activity.notes: Bernaldina José Pedro, known as Vovó Bernaldina, was a prominent Macuxi leader of the Maturuca community in the Raposa Serra do Sol Indigenous Territory and a leading advocate for its recognition. ATLAS uses c.2005—the year of the federal homologation she had campaigned for—as a representative public-leadership boundary, not as a formal accession date. Her activity is attached to her specific community rather than treating her as sovereign over all Macuxi.

sources.title: FUNAI — Vovó Bernaldina, important Macuxi leader
sources.citation_text: FUNAI identifies Bernaldina as an important Macuxi leader from the Maturuca community of Raposa Serra do Sol and a prominent defender of the territory's homologation.

sources.title: Cultura Viva — Prêmio Culturas Indígenas Vovó Bernaldina
sources.citation_text: Brazil's Ministry of Culture identifies her as a Maturuca community leader and master of Macuxi culture.
